definitions.gloss: the genuine article; authentic product from its place of origin
definitions.explanation: A product that comes from its recognized place of origin or production, guaranteeing authenticity and quality.

examples.japanese: これは{本場物|ほんばもの}のチーズだ。
examples.english: This is authentic cheese from its place of origin.

examples.japanese: {本場物|ほんばもの}の{味|あじ}はやはり{違|ちが}う。
examples.english: The taste of the real thing is different after all.

examples.japanese: イタリアで{食|た}べた{本場物|ほんばもの}のピザは、{日本|にほん}で{食|た}べるものとは{全|まった}く{別物|べつもの}だった。
examples.english: The authentic pizza I ate in Italy was completely different from what you get in Japan.

notes:
Composed of {本場|ほんば} (the home/birthplace of something, place of origin) + {物|もの} (thing, product). Emphasizes that the product is from the authentic source, not an imitation or adapted version. Often used for food and traditional crafts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {本場物|ほんばもの}の{味|あじ}: the authentic flavor
- {本場物|ほんばもの}のワイン: wine from its region of origin
- {本場物|ほんばもの}にこだわる: to insist on the genuine article

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {本物|ほんもの}: the real thing, genuine — emphasizes authenticity vs. fakeness; {本場物|ほんばもの} emphasizes origin
- {本場|ほんば}: the home/birthplace of something — the place itself, not the product
- {正真正銘|しょうしんしょうめい}: certified genuine — formal emphasis on absolute authenticity
